title: teucrium × ochroleucum var. cebennense
intro: Teucrium × ochroleucum var. cebennense, commonly known as Mountain Germander, is a variety of the Germander plant, a member of the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Germander include flavonoids, diterpenes, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antiseptic properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Mountain Germander as a medicinal plant.
